queer_characters.name: Marianne
queer_characters.notes: A painter who falls in love with her subject; relationship is central and treated with dignity throughout.

queer_creators.name: Céline Sciamma
queer_creators.notes: Publicly out; frequently discusses her sapphic filmography in interviews.

contributor_notes: French period piece set in 18th-century Brittany. Widely regarded as a landmark of sapphic own-voices cinema.
